comment: She's a very nice person, but I do not like her teaching style. There's no list of things you need to know, she just says random stuff during class and expects us to remember it. I never know what's gonna be on her quizzes/tests, and she also expects everyone to already know a lot about business, which is unfair because not everyone is in bschool.

Profe Hermida-Ruiz is one of the kindest teachers I have met here. I was out sick for a class - she was very accommodating and checked in on how I was. Also has a great sense of humor and is super accessible outside of class. One thing is that she can be disorganized and tell you in class she is changing an assignment, but not update blackboard.

This is my 2nd semester taking Profa. HR. She is a really great teacher who provides solid feedback on writing. Her biggest flaw is that she can be disorganized on blackboard---may change due dates and not update, for example. If you show that you care about her class and learning the language/content, then she'll be more forgiving w/ her grading!

Professora Hermida-Ruiz was great. She clearly cares about her students. You have to talk in class but you should expect that from a Spanish class. There wasn't much homework. Listen in class when she introduces vocab and try to write it all down to prep for quizzes. Overall not that much work and a fair grader.

I took Spanish in Business this semester with Profa. Hermida-Ruiz. She's easily one of my favorite teachers here. She is accessible outside of class and provides good, engaging feedback. 2 things to note is that she cold calls and she's not always thoroughly organized with blackboard---might change due dates/add assignments without updating online.
Professor Hermida Ruiz is such an amazing professor and person. She has a great sense of humor, and is well prepared, organized, respectful and very, very caring. You'll love her class!

Professor Hermida-Ruiz truly cares about each of her students and the material she is teaching, which makes a painful class a little better. She cold calls in class, but lots of times you can get by skimming the readings. She is not the most organized while lecturing, and gives exams in addition to essays which is not normal for most FYS classes.

Very nice women but lectures were confusing and chaotic. Cold calls so you should do the readings. Tough grader on papers but chance to make up for it with presentations. Definitely not the easiest FYS but not horrible.

Shes very easy to reach outside of class and is a very nice professor. Although she does give an insane amount of homework, if you take at least 2-3 hours to do it youll be ok. Also, take advantage of meeting with her because if you do you are sure to get a good grade. However, she sometimes skips around and talks about random/confusing things.
Terrible professor

Personally, I think Dr. Hermida-Ruiz is great, but if you need a super organized professor she isn't for you. Gives good feedback on papers, wants students to succeed, if you skip class a lot you will not get on her good side. The work load wasn't too heavy with this class either!

Im not entirely sure my writing skills improved very much in this class, but shes very nice. Most classes were just her using power points to go through examples. Seemed to me like most students didnt really understand what was going on half the time. But theres not too much work and she is very nice. Would probably take again

Super nice and class is interesting for a writing course. Her quizzes and tests are kind of random of stuff that is determined by students' mistakes but she gives you study guides of what will be on them. There are a few papers that are graded pretty hard but if you spend time on them, A's are reasonable. She is like a kind mom who wants to help u!

Do not recommend her at all. SO disorganized, does not make instructions clear, tests are hard, and just not worth the stress. She acts like she cares about her students but then doesn't organize the class in a way where it benefits her students.

Aurora is a super fun teacher & speaks English often during class. I guess attendance isnt mandatory but i skipped this class a bunch and got a C and then when I took her again, i didnt skip and got an A so.. Definitely one of the best if not the best in the upper-level LAIS classes.. but grading is hit or miss. overall LOVES her students for sure

She is a really tough grader, especially on presentations. essays aren't as bad, but i highly recommended using that writing consultant AND going to see her. LOTS and LOTS of reading, Her class is way more work than it should be for an fys (by 5x). But get on her good side and ask for help as much as you can--youll need it.

Lots of articles to read but interesting information. She loves to talk about Spain and her background so sometimes not all the material is covered in class. Few tests and they are very straightforward. There are a few essays throughout the semester, but she isn't a tough grader.

So far, the best professor I've had at UR. She's charming and motivational. She's also very helpful too. This class requires a lot of readings but do it and I assure you that you won't regret it. The readings are interesting and she sure knows how to connect them to lectures. I would definitely take her class again.

She is super nice and really cares about her students.  There was a lot of reading but it wasn't all necessary.  She can be a bit scatter-brained sometimes but at the end of the day she is a good professor.
I absolutely LOVE her- she is funny and entertaining. If you are serious about learning Spanish, take a class with this professor. She is a hard grader but is extremely helpful and fair.

I don't know if she got easier or it's because I was only in a 302 level class but she's definitely not as hard as everyone says!! a B is definitelyyyy achievable...she wants you to good, she's really nice and helpful and funnnnny!! You get 2 times to do your compositions, and theres a lot of other grades. highly recommended!

Gives rather interesting lectures.  Tests are frustratingly dificult and she grades hard.  A hard class, but I definitely learned a lot.  If you are serious about wanting to learn Spanish, then she will definitely help you.
really sweet lady, but incredibly hard. tests are impossibly and unfairly diffult.

She is an amazing teacher.  She is really sweet and energetic all of the time.  Her class is not boring at all, and she is extremely helpful.  My only complaint is that her exams are rather difficult, and they come to a surprise.  She doesn't appear to be hard during class, but she tends to be strict when grading.  But if you study, you'll be fine!
